display_name: Repository Partition Map And Specialist Routing
validation_rules: partition IDs must be unique; relationship targets must resolve within this map
path patterns must be repository-relative; forbid absolute paths and parent traversal
every partition must cite inspected source evidence and explain its routing
review persona IDs must resolve in the registry; they represent proposed review responsibility, not confirmed team ownership
shared or overlapping path scopes must be explained and assigned a coordinating primary persona
coverage must record unassigned and uninspected scope; absence claims require search evidence
deferred generated, vendored, test, or documentation scope must state a reason and rescope trigger
all claims describe declared or statically inferred structure, never observed runtime state
